title: Treenet
tagline: A decentralized app that rewards ordinary people for participating in reforestation, conservation efforts and green initiatives using carbon offsets and carbon tokens
description: A decentralized app that rewards ordinary people for participating in reforestation, conservation efforts and green initiatives using carbon offsets and carbon tokens. This project uses NFTs to tokenize and track the growing and monitoring of trees so we can help reward ordinary people for these NFTs through carbon offsets and carbon tokens
how_its_made: Its built on polygon network using IPFS to keep decentralized records of new trees and forests being planted.                                                                                      - IPFS                                                                                                                                       - Polygon                                                                                                                                - Ethers JS                                                                                                                          - Remix                                                                                                                               - Moralis
